text:
Type: criss-cross wool area rug
Use: defining a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: Scandinavian, bohemian, coastal
Materials: tufted wool, raised lines, tassel fringe
Colors: ivory white, soft dusty blue
Shape: rectangle, irregular hand-drawn grid lattice in raised pile, tasseled short ends, medium size
Feel: airy, relaxed, fresh
Goes with: charcoal sofas, weathered wood, plants, white walls; Scandinavian, coastal or boho rooms

product.description: 80% Wool 20% Cotton Imported Cool shades of blue and cream crisscross in a whimsical pattern, setting a pleasurable tone to interior spaces.
